item.title: Imo-bilizer!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet
  • 発売日: 2012-08-31
  • スコア: 6.13/10 (85 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹びらいざー!
  • 英語名: Imo-bilizer!

别名

  • Imobiraiza!

あらすじ

The protagonist has a younger sister named Saki. She’s cute, great at studying and excels at sports… pretty much the perfect sister. They aren’t closer than any normal siblings would be. It’s not like he’s a siscon nor she’s a brocon, or at least that’s what he thought. He wondered if he should fall in love with someone, perhaps his older sister-ish childhood friend Izumi, her baby-faced but big-breasted younger sister Mizuumi, or maybe Saki’s cheeky tsundere best friend Yui. But something seemed to be missing. Something that, unbeknownst to him, had always been close to him.

item.title: Comsome! ~combination somebody~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet
  • 発売日: 2010-06-25
  • スコア: 6.9/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: こんそめ！ ～combination somebody～
  • 英語名: Comsome! combination somebody

あらすじ

The protagonist Kyoutarou transferred to “Senshu school” to catch up with his deceased aunt - a troublemaker, infamous for her anti-social and destructive activities. Kyoutarou’s objective is to find his sister, who mysteriously disappeared about ten years ago.

One day, he finds a girl that’s caught in trouble with some ruffian. He helps her escape and treats her a meal, but in exchange she steals his bag and runs away while he is in the washroom.

item.title: Kachou Fuugetsu ~Koi ni Ochitaru Hanazono no Hime~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet
  • 発売日: 2009-12-18
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (27 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 花鳥風月 ～恋ニヲチタル花園ノ姫～
  • 英語名: Kachou Fuugetsu Koi ni Ochitaru Hanazono no Hime

あらすじ

Issei lost his mother…. He was supposed to join an ordinary school, but he is forced to join Hanamiya School, a girls’ school, as a female student. On his first day at school, he meets Anzu, the captain of the student council. Lucky or unlucky, Anzu likes Issei and she appoints him as the executive of the next year’s student council…. Well, will he be able to live a peaceful school life? Like this, his strange school life starts….

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 桜吹雪～千年の恋をしました～
  • 英語名: Hanafubuki Sennen no Koi o Shimashita

あらすじ

Kazunari joins a school as a scholarship student since he lost his parents a while ago. His school is, however, super-rich and he feels somewhat out of place. One day, he saves a female student, Akasha, who was being chased by someone. Akasha is actually from a rich family and now works as the chief manager of school festival. Like this, he starts working with her…

あらすじ

One day, Hayato and Tsuzuri see aurora on their way home astride a broom, and the broom suddenly starts going down. They can’t control it, and just when they hit the ground, they lose consciousness…

item.title: Setsuei
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Silver Bullet
  • 発売日: 2006-03-24
  • スコア: 7.56/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 雪影-setsuei-
  • 英語名: Setsuei

别名

  • yukikage

あらすじ

Shuji was born at a snowy town. His parents died when he was a child and he was adopted by his relatives. He lives in a big city since then. However, he comes back to his hometown every winter to meet his sister. On the day when his parents died, he met his older sister. He could not believe that he had a sister but he accepted her as his older sister to relieve his sadness. They usually live separately but they meet once a year in winter.
